items.title: 4.3.2 Combining Stack and Graph to perform DFS (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of DFS with a stack (PDF 118-120).

blocks.text: Depth-First Search (DFS) ek basic (bunyadi) algorithm hai jo graph ya tree ko explore (har node dekhna) karta hai. Jin vertices ya nodes ko abhi dekhna baqi hai, unhein yeh stack mein rakhta hai. Yeh tab useful (faidemand) hai jab ek shaakh mein jitna gehra ja sakein jana ho aur phir wapas aana (backtrack) ho, yaani gehrai tak dekhne wale kaamon ke liye.
Misal: Figure 4.13 ka graph dekhein, jo numbers wale tree ki shakal mein hai:

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure circles ka tree: oopar 1 se 2, 3 aur 4; 2 se 5 aur 6; 3 se 7; 4 se 8 aur 9.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.13: Numbers wale nodes ke tree ki graph shakal (kitab ki Figure 4.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Nodes 2, 3 aur 4 node 1 ke children hain.
Nodes 5 aur 6 node 2 ke children hain.
Nodes 8 aur 9 node 4 ke children hain.

blocks.text: DFS stack ki madad se is graph ko aise traverse karta hai (stack ko [neeche ... top] likha gaya hai, yaani sab se daen wala number top par hai):

items: Khali stack se shuru kar ke root node (1) push karein.
Qadam 1: node 1 pop kar ke visited (dekha gaya) mark karein. Us ke children 4, 3, 2 is order mein push karein taake 2 top par aaye. Stack: [4, 3, 2].
Qadam 2: top (node 2) pop karein, visited mark karein, us ke children 6, 5 push karein. Stack: [4, 3, 6, 5].
Qadam 3: node 5 pop karein, visited mark karein; is ke children nahi. Stack: [4, 3, 6].
Qadam 4: node 6 pop karein, visited mark karein; children nahi. Stack: [4, 3].
Qadam 5: node 3 pop karein, visited mark karein, us ka child 7 push karein. Stack: [4, 7].
Qadam 6: node 7 pop karein, visited mark karein; children nahi. Stack: [4].
Qadam 7: node 4 pop karein, visited mark karein, children 9, 8 push karein. Stack: [9, 8].
Qadam 8: node 8 pop karein, visited mark karein; children nahi. Stack: [9].
Qadam 9: node 9 pop karein, visited mark karein; ab stack khali hai.

blocks.text: Is misal mein DFS ka order (tarteeb): 1, 2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8, 9.

DFS root (1) se shuru ho kar har shaakh mein jitna gehra ja sake jata hai, phir wapas aata hai. Stack agle dekhne wale nodes sambhalta hai, is liye agli shaakh par jane se pehle har shaakh poori dekh li jati hai.
Yeh program Figure 4.13 wale graph par stack se DFS chalata hai aur har visit ke baad stack dikhata hai, bilkul upar wali table ki tarah. start badal kar (maslan 4) ya children badal kar Run karein.

children = {1: [2, 3, 4], 2: [5, 6], 3: [7], 4: [8, 9]}   # Figure 4.13
start = 1

stack = [start]
order = list()
while stack:
    node = stack.pop()                    # pop from the top
    order.append(node)
    for child in reversed(children.get(node, [])):
        stack.append(child)               # push so the first child is on top
    print("Visit", node, "-> stack:", stack)
print("DFS order:", order)

blocks.explanation: Neighbours (parosi) ko baen se daen (A, B, C ... ke order mein) lein: A, B, E, F, C, G, D, H, I.

items: 9 nodes wale tree par stack wala DFS: 1, 2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8, 9.
